Kai: heads up — I ran a quick entitlement diff across projects and we have 3 admin roles with overlapping scopes. thinking we should consolidate into a single canonical admin role and tighten perms. :thinking_face:
Eleanor: +1 on consolidation. can you paste the diff? curious which bindings are duplicates vs intentionally scoped. :eyes:
Kai: pasted snippet below — duplicates are mostly `roles/editor` + `roles/compute.admin` combos across infra-* projects.
```
projects/*/iamPolicy
- binding: role: roles/compute.admin members: group:infra-admins@redwood.com
- binding: role: roles/editor members: user:alice@redwood.com
+ binding: role: roles/infra.admin members: group:infra-admins@redwood.com
```
Sam: sounds right. suggest we create a narrow `roles/infra.admin` that excludes billing and org-level perms, then run a canary on infra-staging for 48h. monitor audit logs and deploy errors. :+1:
Anika: do we have a list of service accounts that will be affected? want an automated way to flag ownerless svcaccts before the cut. I can run a quick query against our audit logs/iam inventory.
Jordan (ops): I can take the canary + rollback playbook. quick checklist: update KMS bindings, rotation hooks, and secrets-access policies. if infra admin changes, we must update keyRing IAM.
Kai: good catch on KMS — @Eleanor, any concerns updating key ring IAM to reference the new role instead of infra-admins group? We should avoid a transient gap to key access.
Eleanor: we'll need a 2-step plan: 1) add new role to key ring with `gcloud kms keys add-iam-policy-binding`, 2) after verification remove old bindings. no downtime expected if both exist simultaneously. example command: 
```
gcloud kms keys add-iam-policy-binding projects/PROJECT/locations/global/keyRings/kr --key mykey --member=group:infra-admins@redwood.com --role=roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter
```
Anika: here's a small BigQuery snippet to find principals with owner-ish roles so we can triage owners before consolidation:
```
SELECT principal, COUNT(*) as bindings
FROM `org_policy.iam_bindings`
WHERE role LIKE "%owner%" OR role LIKE "%admin%"
GROUP BY principal
ORDER BY bindings DESC
LIMIT 50;
```
security-bot: automated scan report — no active incidents. policy-change window available: Tue 2024-04-09 02:00-06:00 UTC.
Sam: proposed schedule: create role + test in infra-staging on Tue window, run canary 48h, then staging -> prod apply next Thu if clean.
Jordan (ops): I can own the rollback runbook and monitor KMS audit log patterns. will subscribe to alerts for `cryptoKeyDecrypter` errors.
Kai: volunteers — Sam handles role definition (share policy doc), Anika runs pre-cut svcacct ownerlist, Jordan owns canary/rollback, Eleanor handles KMS binding ops. I'll post the PR for the role and tag everyone. follow-up sync in #eng-security tomorrow 10am PT. thanks all. :rocket:
